evidence.paragraph: The Company reported fourth quarter 2025 reported revenue of $3.916 billion, an increase of 9% compared to the fourth quarter of 2024. Fourth quarter GAAP net income increased 29% to $1,134 million and GAAP diluted earnings per share increased 32% to $3.75 driven primarily by strong revenue and operating profit growth in Ratings and Indices. Adjusted net income for the fourth quarter increased 12% to $1.299 billion and adjusted diluted earnings per share increased 14% to $4.30.
